questions.stem: Let \(ABC\) be a triangle right angled at \(C\), then what is \(\tan A + \tan B\) equal to?

questions.stem: If \(\sec\theta + \cos\theta = \frac{5}{2}\), where \(0 \le \theta \le 90^\circ\), then what is the value of \(\sin^2\theta\)?
What is \((1 + \cot\theta - \operatorname{cosec}\theta)(1 + \tan\theta + \sec\theta)\) equal to?
If \(6 + 8\tan\theta = \sec\theta\) and \(8 - 6\tan\theta = k\sec\theta\), then what is the value of \(k^2\)?

A pole on the ground leans at \(60^\circ\) with the vertical. At a point \(x\) metre away from the base of the pole on the ground, two halves of the pole subtend the same angle. If the pole and the point are in the same vertical plane, then what is the length of the pole?

A vertical tower standing at the corner of a rectangular field subtends angles of \(60^\circ\) and \(45^\circ\) at the two nearer corners. If \(\theta\) is the angle that the tower subtends at the farthest corner, then what is \(\cot\theta\) equal to?
A cone and a hemisphere have equal bases and equal volumes. What is the ratio of the height of the cone to the radius of the hemisphere?
A solid sphere of diameter 60 mm is melted to stretch into a wire of length 144 cm. What is the diameter of the wire?

The ratio of the radius of base to the height of a cylinder is \(2:3\). If the volume of the cylinder is 1617 cm\(^3\), then what is the curved surface area of the cylinder? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))

The difference between the outside and the inside surface area of a cylindrical pipe 14 cm long is 44 cm\(^2\). The pipe is made of 99 cm\(^3\) of metal. If \(R\) is the outer radius and \(r\) is the inner radius of the pipe, then what is \((R + r)\) equal to? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))
A metal solid cube of edge 24 cm is melted and made into three small cubes. If the edges of two small cubes are 12 cm and 16 cm, then what is the surface area of the third small cube?

A conical vessel whose internal radius is 5 cm and height 24 cm is full of water. The water is emptied into a cylindrical vessel with internal radius 10 cm. What is the height to which the water rises?
A metal solid cube of side 22 cm is melted to make a cone of height 21 cm. What is the radius of the base of the cone? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))
A cone of height 24 cm has a curved surface area 550 cm\(^2\). What is the ratio of its radius to slant height? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))

A rectangular paper is 44 cm long and 22 cm wide. Let \(x\) be the volume of the largest cylinder formed by rolling the paper along its length and \(y\) be the volume of the largest cylinder formed by rolling the paper along its width. What is the ratio of \(x\) to \(y\)? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))

A hollow spherical shell is made up of a metal of density 3 g/cm\(^3\). If the internal and external radii are 5 cm and 6 cm respectively, then what is the mass of the shell? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))
A cloth of 3 m width is used to make a conical tent 12 m in diameter with a slant height of 7 m. What is the length of the cloth? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))

A sphere of diameter 6 cm is dropped into a cylindrical vessel partly filled with water. The radius of the vessel is 6 cm. If the sphere is completely submerged in water, then by how much will the surface level of water be raised?
A sector is cut from a circle of radius 21 cm. If the length of the arc of the sector is 55 cm, then what is the area of the sector?
A wire is in the form of a circle of radius 70 cm. If it is bent in the form of a rhombus, then what is its side length? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))
flags: Subtopic fit is loose: this is a PERIMETER conversion (circumference of a circle re-bent as the perimeter of a rhombus), not an area question. Mensuration 2D has no perimeter subtopic in catalog.json; filed under the rhombus-mensuration subtopic used by sibling bands. A 'Perimeter and Boundary Length' subtopic would be the honest home.

questions.stem: If the perimeter of a semicircular park is 360 m, then what is its area? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))

In a trapezium \(ABCD\), \(AB\) is parallel to \(DC\). The diagonals \(AC\) and \(BD\) intersect at \(P\). If \(AP : PC = 4 : (4x - 4)\) and \(BP : PD = (2x - 1) : (2x + 4)\), then what is the value of \(x\)?

\(\triangle ABC\) is similar to \(\triangle DEF\). The perimeters of \(\triangle ABC\) and \(\triangle DEF\) are 40 cm and 30 cm respectively. What is the ratio of \((BC + CA)\) to \((EF + FD)\) equal to?
Two isosceles triangles have equal vertical angles and their areas are in the ratio \(4.84 : 5.29\). What is the ratio of their corresponding heights?
\(ABC\) is a triangle right angled at \(A\) and \(AD\) is perpendicular to \(BC\). If \(BD = 8\) cm and \(DC = 12.5\) cm, then what is \(AD\) equal to?
questions.subtopic: Altitudes and Sides of a Triangle

questions.stem: The surface area of a cube is equal to that of a sphere. If \(x\) is the volume of the cube and \(y\) is the volume of the sphere, then what is \(x^2 : y^2\) equal to?
